advert_text:
ANNEXURE F

DEPARTMENT OF HIGHER EDUCATION AND TRAINING
(ORBIT TVET College)
(Gauteng CET College)
(Western Cape CET College)

POST 42/36
:
STATE
ACCOUNTANT:
MANAGEMENT
ACCOUNTING
REF
NO:
GPCETC04/10/2026

SALARY
:
R338 106 per annum (Level 07)
CENTRE
:
Gauteng Community Education and Training College (Ormonde)
REQUIREMENTS
:
Grade 12 (Matric) or equivalent qualification. National Diploma (NQF Level 6)
or Bachelor's Degree (NQF Level 7) in Accounting, Financial Management or
a relevant qualification. At least 2–3 years' relevant experience in management
accounting, budgeting or financial management. Experience in staff
supervision will be an added advantage. Knowledge of the PFMA, Treasury
Regulations and applicable public-sector financial management prescripts.
Knowledge of budget preparation, expenditure monitoring, financial planning
and management reporting. Understanding of budgeting, cash-flow
management and financial analysis. Proficiency in MS Office, particularly
advanced Excel. Knowledge of financial management systems, including
Business Central, will be an added advantage.


DUTIES
:
Coordinate the preparation and consolidation of annual budgets and
projections. Monitor expenditure against approved budgets and analyse
variances.
Coordinate
cash-flow
projections
and
monitor
financial
commitments. Prepare monthly and quarterly management accounts and
financial performance reports. Analyse expenditure trends and identify
potential overspending and cost-saving opportunities. Coordinate budget
adjustments, virements and reallocations in line with approved delegations.
Monitor compliance with the PFMA, Treasury Regulations and College
financial policies. Coordinate budget-related audit schedules, supporting
documents and audit responses. Supervise staff, allocate duties and monitor
performance. Liaise with internal stakeholders on budgeting, financial planning
and reporting matters.
ENQUIRIES
:
Ms. ER Phaladi Tel No: (010) 900 1154 or Mr M Maboe Tel No: (010) 900 1168
APPLICATIONS
:
Applications can be hand delivered to Gauteng CET College, 100 Northern
Parkway, Ormonde 209, Crown Wood Office Park Block D or submit to the
following
email
quoting
the
reference
number
to:
STATEACC04@GP.CETC.edu.za
NOTE
:
Applications must be submitted on Z83 form obtainable from any Public
Service Department or on the internet at www.gov.za/Documents and must be
accompanied by a recently updated comprehensive CV (With Three
Contactable References). A fully completed and signed Z83 form and a detailed
Curriculum Vitae will be considered (PDF document to a maximum of 10
megabytes). The College will not be responsible for server delays. Only
shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified documents/copies of
qualifications and other relevant documents to support the application on or
before the day of the interviews. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have
foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority
(SAQA). Candidates whose appointments promote representativity in terms of
race, gender, and disability will receive preference. The candidate(s) will be
required to sign an annual performance agreement, disclose his/her financial
interests, and be subjected to security clearance. If you have not been
contacted within three (3) months of the closing date of this advertisement,
please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Suitable candidates will
be subjected to personnel suitability checks (criminal record check, citizenship
verification, qualification/study verification, and previous employment
verification). Applications received after the closing date will not be considered.
Gauteng CET College is committed to providing equal opportunities and
practising affirmative action. The appointment will be done in line with the
approved Employment Equity Plan. Persons with disability are encouraged to
apply. It is our intention to promote representativity in terms of (race, gender,
and disability) in the organisation. Due to the College financial constraints,
candidates will be responsible for their traveling and accommodation. The
College reserves the right not to fill vacancies. All shortlisted candidates,
including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a
practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct)
Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an
additional criterion in the interview process.
CLOSING DATE
:
04 December 2026 at 12h00
